comment: Adds the two Uranium Expanded metals as anvil blocks and as ingredients for the recipes that smith them. Their TIERS are not set here: an anvil reads its own tier in BlockAnvil.OnLoaded, looking its metal up in SurvivalCoreSystem.metalsByCode, so the tier has to reach that table rather than this patch. Haft supplies it by shipping assets/haft/worldproperties/block/metal.json - see the note in that file.
